name: gws-connector
description: Multi-account Google Workspace MCP server — Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs, and Slides with smart account routing.
long_description: Connect multiple Gmail and Google Workspace accounts (personal + work, multiple clients, different orgs) and route requests by label, email, or domain. Bring-your-own OAuth credentials; secrets and tokens are stored in the OS keychain. 47 tools across Mail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs, Contacts, Tasks, Slides, and account management.
